author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Support,

The reasons you gave me did not prove that I should have been temp-banned. As you can clearly see in the vid ( http://youtu.be/QCE1rJFl0_k ) I did go close to their spawn but I immediately ran back because I knew I had gone too far. I also didn't actually kill anyone when I was close to their spawn for about a second. Also you say you've warned me, that was 4 months ago. How is that relevant? Even if you have warned me ages ago you should still tell me to back up a bit if I was spawn killing. This is rediculous.

Please reply as soon as possible,

Regards,

DaCrowMan

title: My temp-ban

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
You ran back because you were getting killed. As I said, we have more evidence, but the uploading crashed. Also, the guidelines for spawnkilling state a temp ban, so by now you could have had a 10 day ban. Also, even if you didn't kill anyone, you still attempted to do so.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
